Disassembly of the Combustion 
Component and Piping

Combustion Chamber Accessories 
and Pipes Removal

items:
Remove the atomizing airlines from the fuel 
 nozzle.
Remove the fuel lines from the fuel nozzle.
Disconnect the spark plug leads.
Disconnect the flame detector.

Unlock and remove all fuel 
 nozzles take in consideration to mark the nozzles with its proper chamber 
 number.

Mark each cover with the relative chamber 
 number.
Unbolt and remove the combustion covers.

Remove the combustion liner no 1 as described 
 below:

Remove the crossfire tube clamps from 
 chamber No 1.

Remove the crossfire tube clamps from 
 adjacent chamber N0 2 and No 10.

Push the crossfire tube into adjacent 
 chambers No 2 & No 10.
Remove the liner No 1.

Remove the crossfire tube with the 
 adjacent chamber NO. 2 & NO. 10.
Repeat steps (a) to (e) to remove other liners.

Inspect the crossfire tubes & retainers for 
 (wear, cracks& overheating) and record the results in the attached record sheet

Inspect and maintain the fuel nozzle according 
 to the appropriate procedure and record the results in the attached sheet

Inspect the cap and liner if it should be 
 reused, repaired or scraped according to the criteria and record the results 
 in the attached record sheet

Inspect the transition pieces with strong beam 
 of light and records should be made of any visible cracks, deposits or erosion 
 and record the results in the attached record sheet

Remove the turbine 
 compartment roof with the diesel engine exhaust manifold & CO2 fire fighting 
 piping connected to this compartment

Remove the turbine 
 compartment stand beams adjacent to the turbine shell

Prepare four lifting lugs on 
 the chimney wall above the center lines of the first stage nozzle, the 
 second stage nozzle, right and left side of the shell

Install three support screw jacks below:
 = Discharge compressor 
 forward to after casing flange 
 = Discharge casing to turbine shell flange 
 = Turbine shell to exhaust
 hood

Remove atomizing air & gas 
 manifold and fuel oil lines.

Remove cooling air pipes as necessary for 
 removal of the shell

Remove the two second-stage nozzle axial 
 holding bolts located at 45 & borescope plugs from the upper shell half

Remove the wheel space thermocouples & 
 junction boxes adjacent to Turbine shell.

Remove the vertical bolting between the 
 turbine shell and compressor discharge shell

Remove the vertical Allen head bolts between 
 the turbine shell and the exhaust hood
Remove the turbine shell horizontal bolting

Jack the turbine shell at the jack bolts holes 
 provided to lift the shell case (it is preferable to use four guides during 
 the shell lifting).

Lift the shell casing using mobile crane, 
 lifting wires and hoists as described in the weight and center of gravity 
 drawing

Remove the eccentric pins for positioning the 
 1st & 2nd nozzles upper halves after removing the upper 
 shell case

Check the clearances of the 1st & 2nd 
 nozzle holding clamps

Remove the upper portion of the 2nd stage nozzle 
 holding clamps and the horizontal joint bolting and lift the upper half of the 
 2nd stage.

Remove the allen-head horizontal joint bolts from the inner 
 diaphragm upper half and lift it

Remove the combustion outer casing except the combustors No 1, 
 10, 9

Remove the No 10 transition pieces by removing the bolts with 
 the first stage nozzle and side L seal

Push these transition pieces clear of nozzle into the outer 
 combustion chambers.

Remove the first stage nozzle clamp and the horizontal joint 
 bolting

Lift off the upper half of the first stage nozzle careful 
 attention should be paid to the L-shaped seals between the segments
Remove the upper half of supporting ring.

Take a complete set of turbine clearance and record the 
 results in the attached record sheet

Remove the first and second stage nozzle lower centering pins 
 & second stage axial holding bolts located at 45 & bore scope plugs 
 from the lower shell half.

Untight the seal ring bolts from the first stage nozzle inner 
 support ring and the two axial nozzle clamps.
Remove the first stage nozzle support lugs

Roll out the first stage nozzle by hooking the tow nozzle 
 sides to two-hoist chain hooked on the lifting lug above the first stage 
 nozzle Transvaal axel with the nozzle swinging free.

Raise one hoist cable and lowering the other side until the 
 nozzle brought out above the turbine shaft, and then lift the stage up

Remove the second stage nozzle diaphragm lower half packing 
 (labyrinth) by bushing it out of its groove

Light a rope with wooden blocks of dimension 7*7*12 cm with 
 distance between block of 20 cm around the turbine shaft at the labyrinth 
 packing groove.

Remove the lower half second stage nozzle supporting lugs then 
 remove it by rolling out using two chain hoist hooked on the lifting lugs 
 above the stage axel the lower half of the nozzle and diaphragm must be lifted 
 as one piece.

Inspect the transition pieces with strong beam of light and records should be 
 made of any visible cracks, deposits or erosion and record the results in the 
 attached record sheet

Inspect the first and second stage nozzle for cracks, distortion, blocked 
 cooling holes, loss of metal and corrosion. Repair is mandatory for nozzles 
 exceed the following limits:
Five cracks per nozzle segment 0.5 inch deep and spaced less than 1.0 inch.
Vane trailing edge:

any number of cracks parallel to sidewall and less than 1.0 inch provided 
 that distance between any adjacent cracks is greater than the longer of the 
 two cracks.

Two converging cracks less than 1.0 inch with a part distance less than the 
 total sum of the two cracks.

Two diverging cracks less than 1.0 inch and the length of the crack is less 
 than the distance between the between the end of crack and sidewall.

Vane leading edge: two cracks less than .375 inch and a part distance less 
 than 1.0 inch.

bowing of the trailing edge in excess of 0.035 inch with no more than one 
 incident per segment.
No other partition shall be bowed.

Record the inspection results and record the results in the attached record 
 sheet

Inspect the first & second stages buckets for cracks, torn metal, dents & 
 erosion of loading and trailing edges.

Compare the inspection results with the manufacture limits and change if 
 necessary.
Cut out the heads of lock twist pins by sharp chisel

Bush the bucket in the direction of removed head pay attention to the axial & 
 radial seal pins.

Clean out the bucket groove and remove any proud metal caused by cutting 
 chisel or securing peen marks.

Remove the exhaust turning vanes (diffuser) from the exhaust plenum and slide 
 them back against the load gear.

Enter the exhaust plenum and remove the horizontal joint bolting insulation 
 shields.

Remove the horizontal joint bolts of inner and outer flanges of the exhaust 
 hood.

Use jackscrews to be separate the upper half of exhaust hood from the lower 
 half.

Use 2-ton hoist to left the exhaust hood upper half and hang it up into the 
 stack.

Cut out the heads of lock twist pins of the second stage bucket by sharp 
 chisel.

Push the buckets toward the removed pins head gradually as group pay attention 
 to bucket shield slots.

Clean out the bucket groove and remove any proud metal caused by cutting 
 chisel or securing peen marks.
Arrange the bucket in accordance to the balance sheet.

Place the lock twist pins in their slots and assemble each bucket with its 
 seal pins. (Anti size compound is recommended to use for pines)

Push the first bucket into the rotor grove (2cm) and then install the next 
 bucket, push the tow buckets into their grove (0.5 cm) and assemble the third 
 bucket, push the buckets gradually paying attention to the seal pins.

Rotate the lock twist such that it secure the bucket from moving axial, then 
 punch the lock twist with the two diametrically opposite peen marks with 
 around nosed punch.
Arrange the bucket in accordance to the balance sheet.

Place the lock twist pins in their slots. (Anti size compound is recommended 
 to use for pines)
Assemble buckets with their radial & axial seal pins.
Rotate the lock twist such that it secures the bucket from axial movement.

Punch the lock twist heads with around nosed punch to lock it in the rotor 
 slots with two diametrically opposite peen marks.

Lower the upper half of the exhaust hood and tight the horizontal joint bolts 
 of inner and outer flanges be sure that new gaskets are used on the horizontal 
 joint of the inner gas path cone & the air baffle is properly located in the 
 groove of the seal of bearing NO 2 before lowering the hood.
Assemble the horizontal joint bolting insulation shield.

Assemble the exhaust turning vanes (diffuser) ensure the position of gas seal 
 plates between the diffuser & stack.
Clean thoroughly the turbine shell and discharge casing
Coat the second stage nozzle spring seal with anti seize

Roll in the second-stage nozzle when in position and supported on the lifting 
 rig insert and bolt the support shims.

Lower the second stage nozzle lower half onto the supporting lugs and inserts 
 the bottom eccentric pin.
Assemble the two lower axial holding pins at 45.

Assemble the lower half inter stage packing (labyrinth) and spring adjusts the 
 clearances as recommended by the manufacture drawing

Roll in the lower half of the first stage nozzle and while the nozzle is still 
 supported on the lifting hoist insert the horizontal supporting lugs, bolt 
 then tightly and then lower the nozzle.
Assemble the first stage nozzle bottom eccentric pin.
Tighten the first nozzle bottom holding clamp and check their clearance.

Take a complete set of turbine clearance and record the results in the 
 attached record sheet

Note that the clearances on the packing and the second stage nozzle must be 
 taken while the nozzle is waged against the second stage shrouds (this is its 
 running position).
Assemble the upper half of the supporting ring.
Assemble the upper half of the first stage nozzle.
Assemble the upper half of second stage nozzle diaphragm.
Assemble the upper half of second stage nozzle.

Assemble the clamps to the first stage nozzle horizontal joint and check the 
 clearance of the clamp record this clearance on form GT-4656.

Assemble the second nozzle clamps and record this clearance. and record the 
 results in the attached record sheet

Assemble the two packing strips into the outer seal groove of the first stage 
 nozzle; verify that the lap of the strips is not in line to minimize the 
 possibility of leakage.

Assemble the transition pieces. Starting from the chamber No 5 and work upper 
 wards from that point Be sure that the transition pieces are fully engage in 
 the first stage nozzle before tightening the center holding bolts.

Assemble the side seals (L seals) and locking bolt washer combination between 
 each transition pieces.
Check thoroughly turbine shell cleaning.

Coat the mating surfaces of the turbine shell exhaust hood and discharge 
 casing with a light film of anti-seize.

Check that all is secure within the shell area before assemble, rotate the 
 turbine rotor with ratchet mechanism check if there were any abnormal sound.

Assemble the shells upper half using 4 guide rods and the two jack bolts 
 mechanism pay attention to the turbine shell level during lowering with jack 
 bolts.
Tighten the shell bolts according to the bolting sequence.

Assemble the first and second stage nozzle upper eccentric pins; second stage 
 axial holding bolts at 45 and the bore scope plugs.

Assemble the outer combustion casing using new gasket on the casings and fix 
 them in the groove with grease in two spots.
Remove all support jacks from the unit.
Clean all mating flange faces of any gasket material.

Clean all hardware bolts & nuts with wire-brush to remove traces of anti-seize 
 or rust.
Lock maintained fuel nozzle with steel lock wire.

Assemble liner No 5 to the chamber. Slide the crossfire tubes from chamber No 
 6 & No 4 into Liner No 5.
Assemble liner No 4.

Slide crossfire tube from liner No 5 into position between liners No 4 & No 5 
 and lock it with Retainers.
Follow the a/m procedure for the remaining chambers.

Energize the ignition transformers and observes that the spark plugs are 
 properly work.

Check the flame detector works properly by expose the scanner to suitable 
 light.
Assemble the spark plugs and the flam detector.

Assemble the combustion covers take in consideration that the two larger bolts 
 in the flanges are to be mated with the holes in the cover and casing.
Reassemble the fuel nozzles but do not tighten bolts firmly.

Reassemble the fuel piping and when mating with the nozzle flanges. Tight the 
 nozzle bolts firmly.

Preparation the Unit for Start after Inspection

items: Revise & check the clearness & cleanness of working site.
Check the availability of DC & AC power supplies.
Check batteries voltage should not be less than 105 V.
Check the lube oil level and the fuel oil tank of starting diesel engine.
Check the level of main tank lube oil in normal level.

Operate the emergency lube oil pump check direction of rotation and the 
 discharge Pressure.
Check lube oil flow through sight glass at bearing NO. (1, 2, 3).
Check the level of cooling water tanks.
Check valves position of fuel supply system in operation position.
Check the position of cooling air dampers.

Check readiness of unit (No trip signal is initiated) and the ready light 
 signal is on.

Operate the unit at different speeds (200 
 r.p.m, crank speed, fire position, full speed no load)
Leakage of fuel gas line (test with soapy solution).
Leakage of cooling and seal air pipes.
Abnormal noise or excessive vibration.
Operate the unit at (different loads 0%, 25%, 50%, 100%).

Take complete operation reading and record the results in the attached 
 record sheet.

Re-assembly
